steps.title: Extrude the profile
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as seat_foam.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the YZ Plane: the side profile, 446 deep, 80 high at the front and 50 at the back. Finish Sketch.
steps.note: Fire blocked foam passes the oil burner test for seat cushions (CS 25.853(c)).
